creator: Claude
name: Tool Chest
source_format: MagicaVoxel VOX v150 (SIZE, XYZI, RGBA), single model

derived.glb_note: Derived from the .vox by tools/claude/export_glb.py; do not edit by hand. Linear COLOR_0 vertex colours, one material.

resolution_rationale: 2.5 cm cells: a handheld or small gear item whose handles, straps and blades would be 2-4x too thick at 5 cm. At 5 cm a 0.47 m chest is nine cells tall: its drawers, pulls and casters would be single cells. At 2.5 cm the four drawers, full-width pulls, swivel casters and the open drawer's contents read; the voxel count stays modest.
godot_mapping: godot = ((vx - px) * s, (vz - pz) * s, -(vy - py) * s)
pivot_note: Bottom centre of the occupied footprint at ground level.
dimensions_note: Occupied extents of the voxel grid (X width, Y depth, Z height).
palette: Shared Claude palette v2 (tools/claude/voxkit.py); one material family per 8-swatch row in MagicaVoxel's palette grid.
collision_hint: Box 0.8 x 0.36 x 0.475 m on the body; handle, rag and open drawer are overhangs.
story: A mechanic's rolling chest from the auto shop on the corner, dragged home for the generator tools. The top drawer was left open with a few spanners in it; a greasy shop rag still hangs over the side handle.
notes: Rolling mechanic's tool chest in dusty red, stacked drawers with one open, casters, side handle.
Depth includes the open drawer (+0.12 m beyond the closed pulls).
